name: Joladarasi–Krishnagiri Highway
aka: Formed from parts of the former NH 205 and NH 219 (old numbering)
history: NH 42 crosses the dry, hilly Rayalaseema region of southern Andhra Pradesh. It starts at Joladarasi on NH 67, east of Ballari near the Karnataka–Andhra Pradesh border, passes the towns of Anantapur, Kadiri and Madanapalle, and ends near Krishnagiri in Tamil Nadu, where it meets NH 48, the Bengaluru–Chennai highway. It was stitched together in the renumbering era from parts of the older NH 205 and NH 219.
facts: Only about 4 km of the highway is in Karnataka — most of it (378 km) runs across Andhra Pradesh.
Ends at a junction with NH 48, the Bengaluru–Chennai highway, near Krishnagiri.
Madanapalle, on the route, is the gateway to the Horsley Hills.
